description.value: Coffee Cabin is the second location of the beloved Comox Valley brand Bigfoot Donuts, opened in 2024 near the Comox (YQQ) airport on Ryan Rd. The shop serves handcrafted, made-from-scratch donuts alongside house-roasted specialty coffee, espresso drinks, teas, and a short breakfast-and-lunch menu. A family business with roots in the Comox Valley since 1920, Bigfoot Donuts leans into Pacific Northwest identity and a genuine neighbourhood-bakery vibe.

address.value: 1466 Ryan Rd E, Comox, British Columbia V9M 4E1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bigfootdonuts.com confirms this OSM record is the 'Coffee Cabin By Bigfoot Donuts' second location at 1466 Ryan Rd E, Comox, BC, opened in 2024 near YQQ airport; the phone (250) 339-6330 matches the OSM tag exactly. The site is a live same-day online ordering platform with a full current menu (donuts, baked goods, breakfast/lunch, espresso drinks, teas), confirming the business is open. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM name is 'Coffee Cabin' but the website brands this location as 'Coffee Cabin By Bigfoot Donuts' — the OSM name is a shortened form, not necessarily incorrect, but worth noting.
